description: This file defines the `DocumentRepository` class, which provides CRUD operations, search, and change notification functionalities for managing documents in a Flutter app. It interacts with an SQLite database via a singleton `AppDatabase` and uses streams to emit update events. The class handles secure parameterized queries and manages document change events such as creation, updates, and deletions.

classes.name: DocumentRepository
classes.description: Repository class managing CRUD operations, search, and change notifications for Document objects.

classes.name: DocumentChange
classes.description: Immutable class representing change events (create, update, delete) for documents.

classes.name: DocumentChangeType
classes.description: Enumeration of change types for documents: created, updated, deleted.

methods.name: createDocument
methods.description: Creates a new document record with specified fields and returns the created Document object.

methods.name: getDocumentById
methods.description: Retrieves a document by its ID, or null if not found.

methods.name: getAllDocuments
methods.description: Returns a list of all documents ordered by last update time descending.

methods.name: getDocumentsByFolder
methods.description: Returns documents filtered by folder ID, including null for uncategorized documents.

methods.name: updateDocument
methods.description: Updates specified fields of an existing document, returns updated Document or null if non-existent.

methods.name: deleteDocument
methods.description: Deletes a document by ID, returning success status.

methods.name: searchDocuments
methods.description: Searches documents by name or tags with LIKE queries, ordered by recent updates.

methods.name: moveDocuments
methods.description: Reassigns documents from one folder to another, updating their folder association.
